id: AT-AP-29 (review: standing is the user's words, denials on every path, verified lines only)
note: 0.1.16 review findings: (1) an approval is standing only when the line says standing AND the user's quote-checked words match the spec's standing_words_re; a once deploy a summary labels standing re-asks even with deploy listed (PROBE-P1), and a standing label without standing words reads once in a handoff and is never put back in a plugin turn; (2) a summary approval whose action a call of the session was refused for is listed as denied, re-ask (PROBE-P2); (3) restore and carry read only the hash-verified section line, so a standing twin appended outside the section is never put back (PROBE-P3 with standing words); (4) a context-only segment does not hide a real approval on the same line; (5) an approval without targets does not borrow the next one's; (6) a multi-gate standing approval is allowed only when every gate is listed; a plugin-turn line with changed targets is not put back.
